card.name: Small words before a past-event verb
card.fires_on: Small function words (even, I, has, not, the, then, was, can) in narrative or historical prose, right before a verb or participle that is still to come. Typical in history and story text.

modes.label: Adverb or auxiliary before a verb
modes.description: A linking word such as even, then, not, was or has sits just before the main verb of a historical event.
modes.example: presented to London society and<< even>> invited to visit King George III.

modes.description: A pronoun or modal verb in first-person or story text, right before the main verb.
